title: Apache Mesos variables
description: Configuration variables for Apache Mesos cluster master and agent daemons

MESOS_VERSION.description: Specific version of Apache Mesos to install.

MESOS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install Apache Mesos ('libscript_native' isolates binaries in LIBSCRIPT_HOME, 'system' uses OS packages).

MESOS_ROLE.description: Operational role of this Mesos node ('master', 'agent', or 'local' combined master+agent).

MESOS_MASTER_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Mesos Master HTTP/Protobuf endpoint listens.

MESOS_AGENT_PORT.description: TCP port on which the Mesos Agent HTTP/Protobuf endpoint listens.

MESOS_ZK_URL.description: ZooKeeper connection URI for Mesos master leader election and agent discovery.

MESOS_QUORUM.description: Minimum size of the replicated log quorum required for Mesos master leader election.

MESOS_WORK_DIR.description: Filesystem directory path for Mesos master replicated log and agent task sandboxes.

MESOS_CONTAINERIZERS.description: Comma-separated list of enabled Mesos containerizers (e.g. 'docker,mesos').

MESOS_HOME.description: Filesystem directory or path configuration for mesos (MESOS_HOME).
